notes: All 29 source and 30 target IDs are partitioned exactly once.
The Sd token is read by its morphology, not as a paragogic he: it takes the ASV's into under rule 32's second half, while the article and noun keep the wilderness.
The two purpose לְ's each take the written to under rule 52; the resumptive suffix on עָלָיו is unrepresented for the same reason as v. 9.
